fields.statement: QA at e629ee6d0: built the binary (go build -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza) and ran `rhiza guide build` and `rhiza guide review`: each prints '## Command budget' with 'Never sleep and never poll. No command runs longer than about four minutes; a longer build or test runs once in the background and is waited for once.', naming no language, make or Rhiza command. Ran `rhiza guide install --agent claude` into a temp HOME/repo: the installed rhiza-build and rhiza-review SKILL.md both carry the section. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/guide passes (budget test and token caps).
